title: The Midnight Hollow Anew
author: Elodie Sandoval
blurb: Wren Okafor, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
